caption: The drawing depicts a single glass goblet with a broad, flaring rim and a narrow base. The goblet is predominantly colored deep red for its bowl, while the stem and foot are rendered in shades of light gray and white, suggesting a clear or transparent glass material. The illustration uses highlights and shading to indicate the reflective surface of the glass. The goblet sits centered within a thin-lined rectangular frame, and the background consists of an off-white or beige surface, with some signs of continued aging or yellowing at the edges. The overall composition is simple, focusing solely on the singular goblet without any additional objects or decorative elements.
title: Vase
